items.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 30 at 4:42AM PDT until October 31 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures of 36 degrees or lower will result in frost
formation.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Oregon and southwest
Washington.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 9 AM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Frost and freeze headlines are only issued
through the growing season of April 1 through October 31.
Therefore, frost or freeze headlines will not be issued beginning
November 1, even though similar low temperatures are possible.
Additionally, frost and freeze headlines will no longer be issued
this growing season for the Upper Hood River Valley, southern
Willamette Valley, south Washington Cascade Foothills, and north
Oregon Coast Range as these locations have already experienced a
hard freeze earlier in October.
items.instruction:
Take steps now to protect tender outdoor plants from the cold.
Consider temporarily moving outdoor potted plants indoors if they are
sensitive to cold temperatures.

Consider temporarily covering sensitive plants with a lightweight
cotton fabric (i.e., bedsheets, thin blankets), as this will help
retain heat and provide frost protection for your plants.
